decisive_items: developed lower back pain and a tingling sensation radiating along the posterior aspect of her bilateral lower extremities
0/5 strength of the bilateral lower extremities (MRC scale)
Abnormal T2 cord signal from T8 to T9 disc level downwards to the conus medullaris
response.rationale: R2 is the strongest candidate due to its comprehensive support from the patient's symptoms, examination results, and imaging findings, which are all consistent with a spinal cord injury. R3 is a close runner-up, but its support is mainly based on the MRI findings, which are also present in R2.

rejected.why: negative CSF analysis reduces the likelihood of transverse myelitis
although it provides additional information about the etiology, it is an append-only completion of R2 and does not provide sufficient independent support to be considered the champion
